description: End-to-end run of the dashboard's Live demo (#demo) by two brand-new wallets (lender A, borrower B) we generated for the test, each funded with 0.00006 Base Sepolia ETH. The page ran in headless Edge with a test wallet provider injected in place of a MetaMask popup; it signs with the wallets' keys, and every transaction is a real Base Sepolia transaction. Keys are never recorded.
